summary: Improve finance briefings, feedback and team coordination with practical exercises in variance analysis, RACI and coaching. Explore the course.
lede: Finance leadership training helps finance team leads, analysts and business partners explain financial results and guide day-to-day decisions. Learners practise interpreting budget and cash-flow variances, briefing decision-makers with clear evidence, and using RACI handoffs, coaching and feedback to agree ownership and next steps. Exercises apply these skills to reporting, forecasting and cross-functional finance work.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for finance professionals who need to lead people, explain financial results or coordinate decisions across finance and other functions. It suits foundation-level learners who work with routine financial information and want to develop their leadership and communication practice.
modules: Finance KPI Dashboard and Action Plan
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with workplace finance reports or routine finance processes is helpful. Coding or programming is not required. Excel use is included for financial analysis exercises; spreadsheet confidence is useful.
